dashboard.label: SOC Capstone — Attack Detection Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real SPL detections for the simulated pseudo-attack techniques. Proof of ingestion and detection in one view.

panel.title: Attk101 — SSH Brute Force (Linux auth.log) — top source IPs

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" | stats count by host | sort - count | head 10

panel.title: Attk101 — Windows 4625 failed logons — top source

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4625 | stats count, dc(Account_Name) as accounts_tried, values(Account_Name) as users by host | where count >= 5 | sort - count

panel.title: Attk102 — Local Account Creation (Security 4720) + Admin group adds

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732) | eval action=case(EventCode=="4720","ACCOUNT_CREATED", EventCode=="4728","ADDED_TO_LOCALGROUP", EventCode=="4732","ADDED_TO_GLOBALGROUP") | table _time, host, action, Account_Name, TargetUserName | sort - _time

index=soc_capstone sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational EventID=1 (Image="*powershell.exe" OR Image="*pwsh.exe") (CommandLine="*DownloadString*" OR CommandLine="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR CommandLine="*Net.WebClient*" OR CommandLine="*EncodedCommand*") | table _time, host, User, Image, ParentImage, CommandLine | sort - _time

panel.title: Attk103 — Network connections from PowerShell (Sysmon EID 3)

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational EventID=3 (Image="*powershell.exe" OR Image="*pwsh.exe") | table _time, host, Image, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, DestinationHostname | sort - _time
index=soc_capstone ((sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=1102) OR (sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "EventID>4<")) | table _time host | sort - _time

panel.title: Proof of ingestion — event count by sourcetype

search.query: index=soc_capstone | stats count by sourcetype | sort - count
index=soc_capstone | stats count, sparkline(count,1h) as trend by host, sourcetype | sort - count
